title: Higher tax take unlikely to widen 2027 fiscal space, CPBRD warns

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Tax revenues could rise to P4.854 trillion in 2027 even under a slower economic growth outlook. However, the marginal gain would still be too small to expand the government’s fiscal space materially, the Congressional Policy and Budget Research Department (CPBRD) said. This projection is slightly higher than the Development Budget Coordination Committee’s (DBCC) P4.851-trillion forecast. Under CPBRD’s estimate, tax effort would rise to 14.8 percent of gross domestic product (GDP) in 2027 from 14.7 percent in 2026, compared with the DBCC’s 14.6 percent projection.
